propositions.option_text: For an emergency oral CII requested partial, the pharmacist applies the non-emergency 30-day remainder limit.
propositions.finding_ko: Emergency oral requested CII partial remainder는 발행후72시간이다. Non-emergency written/전자 처방의30일을 적용할 수 없다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy converts an undocumented stock shortage into a patient-requested partial after its shortage clock expires.
propositions.finding_ko: Shortage 경로를 기한 만료 뒤 실제 요청·기록 없이 patient-requested로 바꾸어 연장하지 못한다. Subsequent practitioner request도 실제 요청·기록과 원 발행일 한계가 필요하다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist applies the CII shortage deadline to a Schedule IV partial fill instead of the applicable III–V conditions.
propositions.finding_ko: III–V partial은 refill 방식의 기록, 합계 총량 및 issue후6개월 조건이다. CII shortage72시간과 다르다.

propositions.option_text: A parent or legal guardian requests a permitted partial fill for a minor patient under the federal rule.
propositions.finding_ko: 미성년자 parent 또는 legal guardian은 federal requested partial의 적격 요청자이다. 나머지 허용 조건은 Stem에서 충족한다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist counts each partial fill as a new full quantity authorization.
propositions.finding_ko: Partial은 원 authorized quantity를 나누는 것이며 거래마다 새 full quantity authorization을 만들지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: An unrelated adult with no qualifying authority substitutes a purported partial-fill request for the minor patient’s parent or guardian.
propositions.finding_ko: 연방 규칙이 적격 요청자를 특정한다. 보기에서 qualifying authority가 없다고 한 unrelated adult에게 parent/guardian 권한을 추가할 수 없다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A Massachusetts pharmacy completes a qualifying patient-requested CII remainder at the same pharmacy that supplied the initial partial.
propositions.finding_ko: MA patient-requested CII remainder는 initial partial을 조제한 동일 pharmacy만 공급한다. 요청·기한·수량 조건은 그대로 적용된다.

propositions.option_text: For a stock-shortage CII partial, the pharmacist starts a new 72-hour period when the replacement stock arrives.
propositions.finding_ko: Shortage72시간은 first partial filling부터이다. Replacement stock 도착마다 재시작하지 않는다.

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist uses one full refill authorization for each small partial transaction, even while dividing the quantity of the original fill.
propositions.finding_ko: 원 fill을 나눈 각 partial을 새 full refill authorization으로 소모하는 것은 quantity accounting과 refill 권한을 혼동한다. 기록을 refill 방식으로 하는 것과 새 권한은 다르다.

propositions.finding_ko: 열린 CI/II container는 exact count/measure다. 1,000정 예외는 III–V의 추정계수 규칙에 속하며 CII에 적용하지 않는다.

propositions.option_text: A newly operating registrant records a zero initial controlled-substance inventory when no stock is on hand.
propositions.finding_ko: Controlled business 개시일 no-stock 사실을 initial inventory로 기록하는 처리가 맞다. 첫 shipment까지 기다리는 규칙이 아니다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy overwrites suspected-diversion footage after the ordinary 14-day period without preserving the incident evidence.
propositions.finding_ko: Known/suspected theft/diversion video는 최소2년 보관한다. 일반 최소14일이 지났다는 이유로 incident evidence를 덮어쓰지 못한다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register#1536,12/6/2024 footer

propositions.option_text: A registrant delays the next federal inventory past two years to align it with a convenient year-end count.
propositions.finding_ko: Biennial 최대 간격2년을 convenient year-end count 때문에 넘길 수 없다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: The pharmacy performs CII physical reconciliation at least every ten days in addition to the federal inventory.
propositions.finding_ko: MA CII perpetual inventory는 최소10일마다 physical reconciliation해야 한다. Federal biennial inventory가 그 별도 의무를 대체하지 않는다. 최소 간격10일이 아니라10일을 넘기지 않는 빈도다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register#1536,12/6/2024 footer
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A certified technician zeros out an unexplained shortage as routine data entry.
propositions.finding_ko: Certified tech의 entry 허용과 discrepancy adjustment는 다르다. MOR가 조사하고 MOR 또는 부재 시 pharmacist designee가 적격 adjustment한다. Tech가 unexplained shortage를 routine entry로 zeroing할 수 없다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register#1536,12/6/2024 footer

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy preserves known or suspected theft-related surveillance for the longer applicable retention period.
propositions.finding_ko: Known/suspected theft/diversion surveillance는 일반14일보다 긴 최소2년 보관이 적용된다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register#1536,12/6/2024 footer

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist estimates that opened Schedule IV container merely because it is below Schedule II.
propositions.finding_ko: Stem/보기에는 that container의 수량·선행 지시가 없다. Federal III–V opened-container 기본은 estimate이며 >1,000 tablets/capsules만 exact다. 보기가 >1,000이라고 해설에서 보태면 NO지만 <=1,000이면 estimate 행위 자체는 허용될 수 있다. merely because라는 불충분한 설명을 이유로 universal permission을 부정할 수는 있으나, 실제 stated dispensing action을 항상 위반이라고 판정할 사실이 없다. all-other prerequisites는 미기재 >1,000을 생성하지 않는다. 단일정답 유일성을 보류한다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist records the entire ordered quantity as received before the shipment is delivered and checked.
propositions.finding_ko: Order와 actual receipt는 다르다. 실제 수령한 quantity/date를 기록하고 premises의 balance를 유지한다. 배송·확인 전에 전량을 받았다고 적지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
Mass.Register#1536,12/6/2024 footer

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist omits the opening-or-closing designation because the calendar date is recorded.
propositions.finding_ko: Federal inventory는 calendar date뿐 아니라 opening 또는 close of business 기준인지 명시해야 한다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: The MOR investigates a physical shortage before making an accountable inventory adjustment.
propositions.finding_ko: MOR는 perpetual discrepancy를 조사하고 적격 adjustment를 한다. 조사 없이 shortage를 숨기는 routine entry와 다르다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register#1536,12/6/2024 footer

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist confirms actual receipts before adding a controlled shipment to the perpetual balance.
propositions.finding_ko: 실제 받은 물량·일자를 확인하여 perpetual balance에 반영한다. Federal record도 actual receipt date를 쓰고 MA balance도 실제 premises수량을 반영한다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
Mass.Register#1536,12/6/2024 footer

propositions.option_text: Expired controlled stock awaiting lawful disposition remains secured and accounted for.
propositions.finding_ko: Expired controlled stock도 lawful disposition 전 보안·accountability 대상이다. Expiration만으로 possession과 재고 책임이 끝나지 않는다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register#1536,12/6/2024 footer
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy calculates the practitioner-distribution exception using dollars of pharmacy revenue.
propositions.finding_ko: 5%는 controlled-substance dosage units의 해당 annual distributed분자 / distributed+dispensed분모이며 revenue dollars가 아니다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy knowingly exceeds the distribution limit and waits until year-end to decide whether registration was needed.
propositions.finding_ko: 해당 calendar year에5% 초과가 예상될 reason to believe가 있으면 distributor registration을 확보해야 한다. 실제 knowingly 초과한 뒤 연말 결정을 기다리는 예외가 아니다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: The purchaser treats the ordered quantity as the final receipt record even when only part was delivered.
propositions.finding_ko: Purchaser는 실제 각 item containers received 및 receipt dates를 기록한다. Ordered quantity가 partial delivered의 actual receipt기록을 대신하지 못한다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A registrant grants a properly executed power of attorney before another person signs eligible stock orders.
propositions.finding_ko: Registrant는 타인에게 SI/II 주문권한을 주기 위해 개인별 properly executed POA를 둘 수 있다. 서명권자·두 증인·보관 요건과2026전자서명 허용을 함께 읽었다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A purchaser follows obsolete triplicate-copy handling without retaining the required current executed-order record.
propositions.finding_ko: 현재 purchaser는 executed original의 copy를 남기고 original을 supplier에 보낸다. 필요한 current record를 남기지 않고 obsolete triplicate 절차만 따르는 것은 부족하다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A newly hired pharmacist signs the pharmacy’s Form 222 without the required ordering authority, relying on the pharmacist license.
propositions.finding_ko: Pharmacist license만으로 특정 registrant의 Form222 서명권자가 되지 않는다. 법정 registrant/partner/officer 또는 적격 POA권한이 필요하다. 보기에서 required authority가 없다고 명시한다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy calculates the practitioner-distribution exception using applicable controlled-substance dosage units.
propositions.finding_ko: Dispenser-to-practitioner exception의5% 계산은 해당 controlled dosage units를 사용한다. Applicable은 분자/분모·calendar year·제외되는 LTCF ADS거래까지 포함하며 매출액으로 바꾸지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: An ordinary Schedule II stock purchase uses a patient’s prescription as its sole stock-ordering document.
propositions.finding_ko: Ordinary SI/II registrant stock distribution은 Form222 또는 qualifying digital order가 필요하다. 환자의 prescription은 sole stock-ordering document가 아니다. Specific exempt transaction을 보태지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy uses a Form 222 purchase record as the complete substitute for a reportable controlled-substance loss.
propositions.finding_ko: Form222 stock-ordering 기록은 theft/significant-loss의 Form106을 대체하지 않는다. Form41은 applicable destruction 기록이다. 본 문항은 보고 기한 숫자를 묻지 않지만 현행45일 Form106문언도 확인했다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy checks both the recipient’s registration and the required ordering records before an eligible controlled-stock transfer.
propositions.finding_ko: 받는 practitioner의 appropriate registration/schedule 및 필요한 stock-ordering/transfer records를 확인하는 것은 예외의 조건에 맞다. Familiar business name만으로 대신하지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A departing CSOS signer leaves personal signing credentials for coworkers to continue using.
propositions.finding_ko: CSOS private key/certificate는 holder만 접근·사용한다. 떠나는 서명자가 coworkers에게 personal credentials를 남겨 계속 쓰게 할 수 없다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy considers the recipient’s familiar business name sufficient and omits the recipient-authority check.
propositions.finding_ko: Recipient가 등록되어 그 substance를 dispense할 권한이 있는지 확인해야 한다. Familiar name만으로 authority check를 생략할 수 없다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: An eligible Schedule II stock purchase uses a properly executed Form 222 or qualifying CSOS order.
propositions.finding_ko: Eligible SI/II stock transaction은 properly executed Form222 또는 DEA qualifying digitally signed CSOS를 사용한다. Exceptions는 별도이며 Stem상 모든 다른 조건이 충족된다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A CSOS signer uses the signer’s own valid digital certificate and authorized credentials.
propositions.finding_ko: CSOS signer는 자신의 valid DEA certificate와 authorized private key를 사용한다. 타인공유·만료·revocation 여부 등 통제가 남는다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: The purchaser records actual quantities and dates received against a partially fulfilled order.
propositions.finding_ko: Partially fulfilled order에도 actual containers/quantities와 dates received를 각 수령 기록에 반영한다. Electronic order의 receipt는 원 order와 연결·archive한다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A supplier restarts a 60-day completion period with each partial shipment on the same Form 222.
propositions.finding_ko: Form222의 partial shipments와 validity는 원 order/execution date로부터60일이다. 각 shipment마다 시계가 재시작하지 않는다. Ordinary 거래이며 Defense exception을 보태지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy expecting to exceed the applicable five-percent distribution limit obtains the appropriate registration rather than waiting for year-end.
propositions.finding_ko: 그 해의 applicable5%를 초과할 것으로 예상되면 appropriate distribution registration을 확보한다. 연말 retrospective calculation만으로 면제되지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR Title21 current, up to date2026-11-02; exact section body directly read
